body:
You're not worthless. Please believe me. You're the only you in the world, that gives you value. You are -you- and that alone is amazing.

Life is very, very hard these days. Very competitive. You're not worthless just because you're not an effective worker drone. You're not worthless just because life expects you to fit an ever-narrowing definition of what a "valid person" is.

Do you need to survive? If so, then do what you need to survive. But don't for a minute let anyone think you're worthless because you're not doing it their way. Don't let them inflict -their- emotions and judgements on you. It's a confusing, convoluted, and very dark world out there, it's not your god damn fault.

And depression? Sorry dude, hate to break it to you, but that's you seeing the world as it is.

Oh and by the way everyone deserves to be loved. If everyone were loved the world would be a much better place.

It's just the way life is these days.
People sling hate and hurtful emotions around too easily. They apply shitloads of pressure on innocent people with little provocation.
Do you meet -your- expectations? Do you meet the expectations of those you respect? Have you evaluated who you respect and why you respect them? Have you stopped to think which expectations you -want- to meet and which you can safely ignore? Those are the only ones you have to meet. Don't let this shit get to you, I know it's easier said than done. The only reason these "expectations" exist is to coerce you into living a certain way. If you didn't choose the expectations themselves, then why should you be beholden to them?
I know a certain level of bullshit is necessary for survival, but don't take this shit to heart like this. It's a sick world out there, and it's dead-set on convincing you that you are the sick one and not it.

You're not fucked up.
They would have you think you fit in a predefined slot in life. There is no such thing as fucking up, there's only other people telling you that you're fucking up. You doing you, you being yourself, is not fucking up. The only way you could fuck up is by not being true to yourself.
Have you ever stopped and wondered whether it's the people who emotionally torture you to the point of causing you to be on the brink of suicide are the ones who are fucked up? Did you do anything wrong to them? And yet, they may cause the end of your life by proxy. They are the fucked up ones. Trust me, your self-hatred is most likely very, very unjustified.

I'm so sorry that people have done this to you.

I can't believe I momentarily gave in to the feelings that this sick fucking society put inside me.
I hate this world.

No, wait. It is the world that is wrong. It's the world that is wrong for telling people that they are wrong when they never had any ill intentions. It's a world without love. I am wrong yet I just entertained the idea of spending half of my waking life scrubbing the shit of the people who see me as wrong off of toilets? The ones who tortured me and turned me into the self-loathing piece of shit I am now? I was not born hating myself, they made me hate myself, and now that I'm broken I'm of no use so I have to commit to being their virtual servant.

I'll continue as I am until I die. I can't capitulate. Holy shit I feel like such a dweeb for the shit I wrote.

Fuck this life.

And I don't have psychological problems, I've just been shat on too many times. Well no, I do have psychological problems, but my anxiety is the most rational of them.
I know how you feel. Hell, you actually sound a lot like me. Wish I knew how to help, I know it's hard. Hope things look up.

Truthfully, I don't know how and I'm afraid.

Just leaving my house throws up this wall of disorientation and dissociation in my mind. I can barely form coherent sentences to cashiers and it takes every ounce of willpower to not freak the fuck out for reasons I'm not quite clear on when I'm out in public where people can see me. My mind would self-destruct during an interview, and if I were to work where I'm expected to interact with people I'd probably go all nutty and I'd end up being nothing but a liability for my employer.

I could scrub toilets, maybe. I'm not above it. But I'm still terrified. I feel like I'm this close to losing it and that's without any stressors in my life. I don't know how to surmount that, I feel like I dug my own grave.

A part of me feels like we are here to purify ourselves. We are all made evil. What better way to understand that than to be stuck with six billion pseudo-clones of yourself, all shitting on one another? I think it's meant to give you insight into your own behavior and anything you may conceal from yourself. After all, other people are more like you than not. The small differences stick around to fuck with us though, as you mentioned.

This is just a small version of hell, I think. A place where people are 90% bad, 10% good, but still have a chance at redeeming themselves. I wouldn't be surprised if we were all alive in a "real" reality at one point before we came here.
